notes.title: 🎆 Starfire Skies Update: Choose Your Path, Upgrade Cards, and More! 🐍✨
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Firework Artists![/h2]

A major update has arrived in Starfire Skies, bringing new strategic depth, fresh challenges, and an exciting new audience member! Here’s what’s new:

[h1]🔥 Choose Your Path with Maps![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472019/19b8de8b31ca40c5d4e3b090220ed0ca5073d306.png[/img]
You now have control over your journey! Each show features a map with branching paths, letting you choose your route through different events, upgrades, and challenges. Pick wisely to set yourself up for a spectacular finale!

[h1]🃏 Upgrade Your Cards with Talismans![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472019/ed3248f52db6a78614386cb3d1b48b710635d6c3.png[/img]
Introducing Talismans, powerful upgrades that enhance your firework cards in unique ways! Find the right combinations to create dazzling displays and boost your performance.

[h1]🎭 New Events & Encounters![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472019/a97d20a4c7b89a418711e6fac579ed59ab8ac06f.png[/img]
Discover new events that bring unexpected twists, rewarding choices, and opportunities to make each show unique.

[h1]🐍 A New Audience Member Joins the Show![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472019/21eac9ef0036234d1cb105d4e1b43c92ddd2227a.png[/img]
Say hello to our latest critic—the Snake! This mysterious new spectator has their own preferences and expectations. Can you put on a performance that earns their approval?


[h3]This update brings more strategy, more choices, and more fireworks to your journey through the skies! 🚀[/h3]

Jump in now and try out the new features! As always, I’d love to hear your feedback, so let me know what you think in the Community Hub or on Discord.

🎇 Good luck, and may your fireworks light up the night! 🎇

🔹 Follow & Wishlist Starfire Skies to stay updated!

notes.title: 🌟 Update 0.2.2: New Characters, UI Overhaul, and Audience Effects! 🌟
notes.content:
Firework enthusiasts, we’ve got an explosive update for you! Starfire Skies has just gotten more dazzling and challenging with new characters, fresh UI changes, and gameplay-enhancing audience effects. Here's what’s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472019/30f851a0c14b460019431cc86c51e883a512d2da.png[/img]
[h1]🐂 New Characters and Variations[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Character: The Horse and the YellowStarbeing are ready to join your firework performances!
[*] Character Variations: Expanded variations for the Ox, Rat, and Goat to keep the show dynamic.
[/list]
[h1]🎇 UI Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Audience and Show UI have been revamped for a smoother, more intuitive experience.
[/list]
[h1]👥 Audience Effects for Added Challenge[/h1]
[list]
[*] Disruptive Effects: The audience now introduces negative stack color card effects, making each show a strategic puzzle.
[*] Yawn Effects: Adds Protect to the audience's Starfire Gauge, making it tougher to fill.
[*] Restless Effects: The audience can now increase their demands for finale or round launchers, keeping you on your toes!
[/list]
[h2]🔥 Ready to dive in?[/h2] Let us know your thoughts, and if you encounter any bugs or have ideas, we’d love to hear from you!
[h2]👉 For more updates, feedback, and bug reports, [color=#7289da][url=https://discord.com/invite/rJth5WzJDN]Join the discord[/url][/color][/h2]
Thank you for supporting Starfire Skies and making it even more spectacular! 🌠
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472019/8ae44c3014e6c8ad7bd4a7efc4be71cd06d5496b.png[/img]

notes.title: New Demo Out Now! 🚀
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! I'm thrilled to share some exciting news with you: the latest demo for Starfire Skies is live and ready for you to play!

What’s New in the Demo:
🌟 New Gameplay Mechanics: Experience the new round based system where you decide when to launch fireworks and how to appease the audience
🔥 New Content: Explore all the all-new cards, characters, artifacts, and events.

Check out this sneak peek of the new demo in action below!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472019/d543d8551720cf435944c76aeb6292083891477e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472019/2453cd148e0d4efbd06abda3dd30e1bdb9159c86.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472019/d74d21a2974615669064cb390de6252b79f01531.png[/img]


[h2]Download and Share Your Thoughts:[/h2]
Download the demo now and let us know what you think! We’d love to hear your feedback in the community hub or discord. Every bit of input helps us improve the game and bring you the best experience possible.

[h2]Let’s Chat:[/h2]
Found a bug or have some cool ideas? Feel free to drop by our discord or leave a comment below. We’re all ears and looking forward to hearing from you!

Thank you so much for your continued support! Your feedback helps us make Starfire Skies the best it can be. We can’t wait to see what you think!

And stay tuned—there’s more exciting content coming soon!
